parsed.name: ai_power_global
parsed.strategy: Bet on the AI power bottleneck expressed through names with a dated observable inside the six-month window: GEV/NVT/VRT for grid, cooling and transformers, MU/TSM/ASML for the memory and tool layer AI capex actually buys, and large-cap pharma with one-sided revision flow (MRK, ABBV, AMGN, ARGX) as the non-AI ballast. Small binary PDUFA names are sized at 2-4% because CRLs average -13.7% on the day and -33% over five days. I would be wrong if hyperscaler capex pauses (killing the power and memory sleeve at once), if a single macro or FX shock hits the correlated AI complex, or if the Q4 PDUFA slate produces more CRLs than the base rate implies.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return versus SPY, net of costs, via dated AI-power and catalyst observables.
